### Libraries
``` {r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
```

# Read and clean Baltimore data
``` {r read_process_data}
homicides <- read_csv("../data/homicide-data.csv") %>% 
  mutate(city_name = paste0(city, ", ", state),
         reported_date = ymd(reported_date))
# break pipe to preserve full dataset for other analysis
balt <- homicides %>% 
  filter(city_name == "Baltimore, MD") %>% 
  mutate(year = year(reported_date), 
         month = month(reported_date, label = T, abbr = F))
```

# Create monthly plot
``` {r monthly_plot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 2}
# define months in each season
summer <- month.name[5:10]
winter <- month.name[c(1:4,11:12)]
# make monthly plot
balt %>% 
  group_by(year, month) %>% 
  summarise(monthly_hom = n()) %>%
  mutate(month_year = my(paste0(month, year)), 
         season = case_when(month %in% summer ~ "Summer",
                            month %in% winter ~ "Winter")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reported_date)) +
  geom_bar() 
```
